description: This Java class 'JpaDomainDao' implements data access object (DAO) for 'Domain' entities, providing methods for querying and manipulating domain data, including OAuth2 client management, within a SQL database using Spring Data JPA.

classes.name: JpaDomainDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing 'Domain' entities with methods for CRUD operations and OAuth2 client management, extending JpaAbstractDao and implementing DomainDao.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO, which is 'DomainEntity'.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated 'Domain' data filtered by tenant ID and optional text search.

methods.name: countDomainByTenantIdAndOauth2Enabled
methods.description: Counts domains for a tenant with OAuth2 enabled or disabled.

methods.name: findOauth2ClientsByDomainId
methods.description: Finds OAuth2 clients associated with a specific domain.

methods.name: addOauth2Client
methods.description: Adds a new OAuth2 client to a domain.

methods.name: removeOauth2Client
methods.description: Removes an OAuth2 client from a domain.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all domains associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is 'DOMAIN'.
